---
title: "04 · Clinical Interpretation — Pediatric Dose Recommendation"
---

**Conclusion:** The minimal PBPK model with allometric clearance reproduces
adult IV PK within 20% across the concentration–time profile. Pediatric
extrapolation (6 yo, 25 kg) with linear volume scaling and BW^0.75^
clearance scaling predicts approximately 35% higher AUC/mg/kg relative to
the adult reference, driven by lower hepatic blood flow and reduced CLint
at reduced liver mass.

To achieve AUC equivalence with the adult 1 mg/kg IV dose, the pediatric dose
should be adjusted to **0.7 mg/kg**. This correction falls within the range
typically supported by ontogeny-naive allometric scaling and warrants
validation in a dedicated pediatric PK study.
